prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted to change lanes from the adjacent lane and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact produced a sideswipe collision with scraping and crushing damage along the left rear quarter panel and door, which is consistent with the reported point of contact described at the scene. Driver 1 stated that his left knee struck the interior trim during the impact and reported pain at the scene. The injury described fits the direction and force of the collision. Passenger was seated in the front right position and was confirmed present in the vehicle by both drivers and by the responding officer. Scene photographs taken by the officer show the damage and debris field, though no independent witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Vehicle records and the owner's statements indicate no prior damage to the vehicle in the area involved. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle. Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the time of the report pending further review.
